heading: Hyderabad horror: Auto driver beaten to death in Rs 10 change dispute
author: TOI City Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM /  Sep 21, 2026, 07:53 IST
paragraphs: HYDERABAD: An auto-rickshaw driver was allegedly beaten to death following an argument over Rs 10 change in Vattapally, under the jurisdiction of Rajendranagar police station, on Sunday evening, according to ANI.Police said an altercation broke out between the driver and a group of people over the change amount, following which he was allegedly assaulted.Police, along with local AIMIM leaders, reached the spot after being alerted about the incident.A police official said, “We have registered a case, and investigation is underway.”You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Hyderabad | Silver Rate in Hyderabad | Bank Holidays in Hyderabad | Public Holidays in Hyderabad | Hyderabad AQI | Weather in Hyderabad | Petrol Price in Hyderabad | Diesel Price in Hyderabad | CNG Price in Hyderabad | LPG Price in HyderabadStay updated with the latest Hyderabad news
